_comment: Candidate experiments, priced by scripts/epistemics.py plan --spec this-file.
EVERY prior_mean AND prior_sd BELOW IS A DECLARED JUDGEMENT, NOT A MEASUREMENT.
They are committed here so they can be argued with and so a later reader can see
what was believed before the data was touched — which is the whole point of
pre-registering a prior. Change them and re-run; the ranking is reported alongside
its inputs for exactly that reason.
prior_mean is the believed TRUE annualised Sharpe of the effect. 0.0 is the
program's own measured base rate across 35 families and is the default that needs
no justification; anything above it does.
n_obs is the sample that ACTUALLY EXISTS on disk, not the sample one would like.
cluster_size/icc encode the day-clustering correction (doc 278): nominal n is not
effective n, and a design that is powered on the former and not the latter should
omega = 0.25 is the epistemic learning rate. It temper the likelihood because the
model is misspecified (non-stationarity; docs 277 and 296 both saw results fail to
survive retest). Set omega = 1.0 to see the optimistic bound.

designs.name: sevp_event_vol_carry
designs._note: doc 304 CORRECTION: n_obs was 1200, which is not on disk (603 events known, 205 with two-leg coverage). This file's own rule is that n_obs is the sample that ACTUALLY EXISTS. The '~70%/~18% validated ceiling' was an unrecorded doc-293 assumption chain (M4: UNMEAS). SEVP is trial T00029, UNRESOLVED-BY-DEATH since 2026-09-01; its frozen structure is a naked short straddle Alpaca cannot express. Disposition is Pierce's. Do NOT build from this row.

designs.name: rocket_gate_forward_ledger
designs._note: Already armed and collecting (n=3/30, DEAD at 60). Listed to show what a 30-observation gate can and cannot establish. prior_mean 0.0 because its parent family is closed.

designs.name: kalshi_zero_capital_shadow
designs._note: Collecting (~2/200 resolved). A genuinely new mechanism class, so the diversity term rewards it; zero capital at risk while it collects.

designs.name: rv_forward_shadow_ledger
designs._note: LIVE forward confirmation of doc 291 (n>=60 bar, review-dead at 120).

designs.name: vol_score_risk_shaping
designs._note: Doc 291 Stage-1 gates passed but the mean point is negative and the proposal is HELD. prior_mean 0.0 records that honestly. Within-day clustering is heavy for a per-name risk overlay.

designs.name: overnight_etf_excess_of_cash
designs._note: Doc 297 measured 1.03 bps/day excess-of-cash with an interval spanning zero, and computed 3,079 sessions to certify it beats a T-bill. 11 years is 2,772 - still short. Included so the planner says so rather than the analyst. | doc 304: fails the 2026-09-22 directive's registration floor (gross >= 20 bps/ticket): 1.03 bps/day. M4 (doc 298) also keeps the family CLOSED, with four of its five objections bar-free. A planner ADMISSIBLE is a statement about information value, not a licence to register.

retired.name: anomaly_vol_scale_monetisation
retired._note: Doc 290 left behind a durable positive: volatility SCALE is predictable (rho ~0.30, attack-survived) while direction is not. Recorded as an archive anomaly. Wholly new mechanism class, so the diversity term favours it heavily; prior_mean is low because doc 290 also judged it unmonetisable in this account.
retired._retired: doc 304: NO MEASURED ROUTE. The entry named no instrument, so it could not satisfy the doc-296 executable-prereg rule, yet the planner priced it ADMISSIBLE. Every concrete route is measured or closed (T00033 index short vol; doc-298 M2 vol-managed SPY is a drawdown tool, IR +0.08/-0.04), except the delta-hedged index VRP, which is unmeasured and needs purchased SPY IV history. CORRECTION: 'no options' was false (4-ticker probe); 202/496 doc-290 tickers are optionable. The route fails on cost (~81% of premium round trip below $5) and horizon (60-minute upside run-up is not an option payoff); long single-name options on that subset are unmeasured.

retired.name: letf_close_window_retest
retired._note: Revived by the target re-scope. prior_mean set BELOW doc 298's 1.33-1.91 ceiling-implied Sharpe because a ceiling is an upper bound, not a central estimate. n_obs = 666, MEASURED from the warehouse with DuckDB on ts_et (2024-01-16..2026-09-17), not the 650 estimate this file originally carried - doc 300 corrected it and the reproduction command must agree with the document.
retired._retired: doc 304: retired. doc 303 VOIDED the LETF family (REFUTED_BY_ARITHMETIC: R^2 >= 47.6% needed vs 2-3% published; 5.8-9.2x Sharpe short with denominators matched) but did not retire these rows, so the planner kept ranking the voided family #1 and #2 ADMISSIBLE. Found by rerunning the planner while writing doc 304.
